retrieval.name: Retrieval
retrieval.description: Known facts, explicit rules, or patterns. Best answered by retrieval from known sources.
retrieval.when_to_use: Fact lookup, documentation lookup, standard procedure questions

first_principles.name: First Principles
first_principles.description: Reason from fundamental truths rather than analogy or convention.
characteristics: Requires deep understanding of domain fundamentals
first_principles.when_to_use: Novel problems, novel constraints, no prior art available

margin_of_safety.name: Margin of Safety
margin_of_safety.description: Estimate under uncertainty with buffer for residual error.
margin_of_safety.when_to_use: Estimation, capacity planning, risk assessment, budget allocation

first_and_margin.name: First Principles + Margin of Safety
first_and_margin.description: First principles reasoning combined with safety margin estimation.
characteristics: Must reason from fundamentals AND size safety margin
High uncertainty + high cost of failure
first_and_margin.when_to_use: Novel engineering problems, novel architecture decisions, novel algorithm design

analogy.name: Analogy
analogy.description: Map known solution from one domain to novel situation.
characteristics: Known solution exists in different domain
Structural similarity more important than surface similarity
analogy.when_to_use: Cross-domain problem solving, analogy-based design, borrowing solutions from other fields

invention.name: Invention
invention.description: Create genuinely novel solution with no precedent.
invention.when_to_use: Truly novel problems, breakthrough innovation, first-of-kind solutions

salience.name: Salience
salience.description: Determine what to attend to and what to ignore.
salience.when_to_use: Information overload, complex multi-source input, prioritization decisions
